features: [UP TO 2.5K UHD VIDEO RECORDING]: Capture everyday moments, travel experiences, POV footage and personal videos with enhanced clarity. The camera offers multiple selectable video-resolution options, including 2.5K UHD, 2K, 1080FHD and 1080P, allowing you to choose the preferred quality according to your recording needs

[180° ROTATING LENS FOR FLEXIBLE POV SHOOTING]: Adjust the lens up to 180° to conveniently frame different shooting angles. Whether you are recording travel moments, daily activities, outdoor adventures or handheld POV footage, the rotating design gives you greater freedom to position the camera the way you need

[1.9-INCH SCREEN WITH IN-CAMERA PLAYBACK]: The built-in 1.9-inch display makes it easy to operate the camera and review your captured content. Switch to Playback Mode to browse saved photos and videos directly on the camera, play recorded videos, adjust playback volume and delete unwanted files without first connecting to another device

[16X DIGITAL ZOOM & BUILT-IN FILL LIGHT]: Get a closer view of your subject using up to 16X digital zoom for supported shooting and viewing functions. The integrated fill light provides additional illumination when required, making the camera more versatile for different everyday recording environments

[VIDEO + PHOTO + AUDIO RECORDING]: More than just a vlogging camera—the compact device supports video recording, photo capture and audio recording for greater flexibility. A built-in microphone captures audio during supported recordings, while the integrated speaker allows compatible sound playback directly from the camera

[RECHARGEABLE 3.7V BATTERY WITH UP TO 7-HOUR USE]: Designed for extended everyday recording with a built-in 3.7V rechargeable battery and up to 7 hours of operating time under compatible usage conditions. Recharge conveniently through the charging/data port, while the charging indicator helps you check charging status. Actual battery runtime may vary according to resolution, screen, fill-light and usage settings

[SUPPORTS TF/MICROSD CARD UP TO 128GB]: Save more videos, photos and audio files locally with support for a compatible TF/microSD card up to 128GB. The removable storage design makes it convenient to manage and transfer your recorded content. Memory card compatibility may vary; card sold separately unless specifically included in the package

[12-LANGUAGE INTERFACE & EASY BUTTON CONTROLS]: Designed for convenient everyday operation with support for 12 interface languages. Dedicated Up, Down, Power, Photo/Record and Mode controls make it easy to navigate settings, change options, capture content and access saved files without complicated controls

[COMPACT VLOGGING & EVERYDAY POV CAMERA]: The lightweight pocket-friendly design makes the camera convenient for vlogging, travel, daily-life recording, outdoor activities, personal documentation and POV videos. The built-in lanyard attachment point also provides another convenient way to carry the camera when you're on the move

[QUICK USE TUTORIAL]: Insert a compatible TF/microSD card and fully charge the camera before first use. Long-press the Power button to switch the camera on, select the required photo/video mode, choose your preferred resolution from the Settings menu, short-press the Photo/Record key to capture photos or start/stop supported recording, use the Up/Down keys to navigate available options, press the Power button as instructed to enter Playback Mode where you can browse saved photos/videos, select a video to play it directly on the camera, and when finished long-press the Power button to shut down
